100 Years Ago Today, This is What Was Happening ...

On August 21, 1926, the world was abuzz with significant developments. In Italy, Benito Mussolini's government announced stricter controls over press and public opinion, tightening its grip on power. Meanwhile, in the United States, the ongoing battle against Prohibition intensified as various cities reported increased speakeasy activity. In global affairs, tensions remained high in the Middle East, with reports of unrest in Palestine amid rising nationalist sentiments.
